name: io.github.MartinSwiss/a11y-probe-mcp
title: A11y Probe
description: Paid WCAG scans for AI agents over MCP, settled with x402 USDC on Base.

tools.name: get_pricing
tools.description: Prices in USD, rate and daily limits, and links to the terms and privacy notice. Automated checks find roughly 57% of WCAG issues. Free.

tools.name: check_contrast
tools.description: Contrast ratios for up to 50 caller-supplied color pairs. No page is fetched. Each pair reports the WCAG 2.2 ratio, AA and AAA for normal and large text, the 3:1 non-text result, and a nearer foreground when AA is not met. Price 0.01 USD in USDC on Base, settled after a successful check.

tools.name: check_links_meta
tools.description: Title, meta description, language, viewport, canonical, headings, and Open Graph fields for one public page, plus up to 50 links on that page. authorized is true. No further pages are crawled. Price 0.05 USD in USDC on Base, settled after a successful check. Automated checks find roughly 57% of WCAG issues.

authorized.description: True when the caller may scan this URL.

tools.name: scan_page
tools.description: One public page checked for WCAG issues. authorized is true. No login, cookies, or stored page content. Price 0.05 USD in USDC on Base, settled after a successful scan. Automated checks find roughly 57% of WCAG issues.

authorized.description: True when the caller may scan this URL.

tools.name: scan_site
tools.description: Up to 10 same-origin pages, starting from start_url. authorized is true. Price 0.50 USD in USDC on Base, settled after a successful scan. Automated checks find roughly 57% of WCAG issues.

authorized.description: True when the caller may scan this URL.

tools.name: report
tools.description: A template Markdown accessibility report in de, fr, or en, with a prioritised fix list. Not legal advice and no compliance guarantee. No model calls. Price 1.00 USD in USDC on Base, settled after a successful scan.

authorized.description: True when the caller may scan this URL.
